description: Object-oriented filesystem paths, directory navigation, file inspection, and file tree manipulation morphisms.

typestates.unresolved_path: Path instance that may or may not exist and has not been normalized.
typestates.absolute_path: Path instance with fully resolved absolute filesystem coordinates.
typestates.existing_path: Path verified to exist on current filesystem.
typestates.directory: Path referencing an existing directory node.
typestates.directory_created: Directory newly created or verified present on filesystem.
typestates.file: Path referencing an existing regular file node.
typestates.file_created: File newly created or touched on filesystem.
typestates.file_renamed: File or directory path successfully renamed.
typestates.hardlink: Path referencing a hard-linked filesystem node.
typestates.glob_pattern: String representing search glob pattern with wildcards.
typestates.paths_list: Collection of Path objects resulting from query or traversal.
typestates.text_payload: In-memory string content for read or write operations.
typestates.binary_payload: In-memory bytes content for read or write operations.
typestates.byte_count: Integer count of bytes written, transferred, or measured.
typestates.stat_metadata: POSIX stat metadata object describing filesystem attributes.
typestates.disk_usage_tuple: Namedtuple storing total, used, and free disk space.
typestates.string_name: String representing path leaf or segment name.
typestates.string_extension: String representing file suffix or extension.
typestates.string_parts: Tuple or list of component parts of a path.
typestates.command_name: Executable binary or command name string.
